snippet.title: Chimpology Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
It's the year 1999.
Your job as a chimpanzee router is to route web traffic, bit by bit.
Type Bits, Get Bananas.

Out on Steam now.
http://store.steampowered.com/app/604010

Music from Chimpology available on Soundcloud:
https://soundcloud.com/themorfeus/sets/chimpology
